transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on this week's disposition board. We have three items to review today: generator G-14, tablet set T-22, and electric pallet jack P-6. I'd like to hear from the property, supply, and maintenance representatives on the current status of each item before we determine final disposition. Who'd like to start with the status on generator G-14?
